summary: Main computes floor(dim²/sparsity) nonzeros and CSR terminal row delimiter n. CudaSpmv selects width 1/2/4/8/16/32 from average row length and chooses a separate 128-thread long-row kernel at average>=512; blocks are capped but each kernel grid-strides rows. Each row kernel traverses its full CSR interval with two width-strided accumulators, reduces, and lane 0 writes. run warms once, captures min(iterations,256) launches when batch>1, then times iterations/batch graph launches plus iterations%batch direct launches; with batch=1 the single direct launch handles the sole iteration. The complete compiled run, selector/constructor and all seven called CUDA stubs were traced to launch calls; all six short-row and the long-row native sm86 SASS bodies include their nonzero/row loops and stores.
